title: The Severe Screen Fatigue Fix
target_audience: Office workers, developers, late-night readers, students

beats.name: The Scroll-Stop Hook
beats.inflection: [Intense Whisper / Shocked Eye Contact / Sudden Peak]
beats.text: If staring at screens all day gives you migraines, watch this right now.
beats.visual_action: Creator rubbing tired eyes under harsh fluorescent desk lamp.

beats.name: The Setup & Entities
beats.tone: rapid-fire matter-of-fact delivery and fast tempo
beats.text: By five PM my eyes were burning, but I still had thirty pages of contracts to review.
beats.visual_action: POV shot of glaring 4K monitor filled with tiny 10pt black-and-white text.

beats.name: The Dramatic Twist
beats.tone: incredulous and shocked with building excitement
beats.text: Instead of ruining my vision, I opened VoiceReader, plugged in my AirPods, closed my eyes, and effortlessly soaked up every single detail while reclining in the dark.
beats.visual_action: Creator taps AirPod into ear, slumps comfortably into couch, eyes peacefully closed.

beats.name: The Moral Dilemma & Question
beats.tone: amused deadpan and engaging rising intonation
beats.role: Viral Engagement Engine: prompt debate in comments
beats.text: Would you rather read with your eyes, or listen like this every day?
beats.visual_action: Creator opens one eye, smiling relaxed at camera.
